reports.title: Li Auto Inc. Announces Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects:
· | Deliveries of vehicles to be between 110,000 and 115,000 vehicles, representing a year-over-year increase of 0.7% to 5.3%.
· | Total revenues to be between RMB31.7 billion (US$4.7 billion) and RMB33.1 billion (US$4.9 billion), representing a year-over-year increase of 10.1% to 15.1%.
This business outlook reflects the Company’s current and preliminary views on its business situation and market conditions, which are subject to change.
